name: iiif-worker
description: IIIF Image API 3.0 server on a Cloudflare Worker you deploy yourself: arbitrary region, size, rotation, quality and format from images in R2, with the image work done in WebAssembly and no server process to operate.
author: mkpoli

IMAGES.description: R2 bucket holding the image pyramids and collection manifests. Created for you; the ingest CLI writes into it.

MAX_AREA.description: Largest output in pixels a request may ask for. A Worker has 128 MB and a decoded pixel costs four bytes, so raising this far above the default risks requests failing on memory. Unset or non-numeric falls back to 12000000.

MAX_WIDTH.description: Optional. Largest output width in pixels. Given without MAX_HEIGHT it caps both axes, which is what the specification says a lone maxWidth means.

MAX_HEIGHT.description: Optional. Largest output height in pixels. The specification only allows this alongside MAX_WIDTH, so setting it alone applies the same value to both axes.

PUBLIC_BASE.description: Optional. The absolute base your images are served under, ending in /iiif/3. Leave unset and the service uses the hostname each request arrived on; set it only when clients reach the Worker under a different host, as behind a proxy.

INGEST_TOKEN.description: Secret enabling uploads through the /ingest route. Unset, that route stays closed and the deployment serves read-only. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 24`.

scripts.check: biome check src ingest test bench && tsc --noEmit
scripts.fix: biome check --write src ingest test bench
